# meta-whatsapp-rs

> A Rust toolkit for Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API, Graph v25.0): a typed Graph API client, verified and typed webhooks, storage, transport and sink adapters, a CMS inbox, a bot framework, Typst documents, and meta-whatsapp-server, an HTTP service for apps not written in Rust.

Users are keyed by business-scoped user id (`user_id`, BSUID), never by phone number alone: from 2026 every webhook carries one and `wa_id` may be absent. Errors branch on `ErrorKind`, never on messages. Every link below is the Markdown source on `main`; the rendered site is https://vaam-apps.github.io/meta-whatsapp-rs/.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/README.md): the crates, quick starts for each product, feature flags and the service
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/docs/getting-started.md): adding the dependency, the feature flags, the crates and the runnable examples
- [Which guide for which job](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/docs/guides/README.md): the integrator guides, by product

## Guides

- [Meta setup and first message](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/docs/guides/getting-started.md): the app, WABA, number and system user token on Meta's side, then a first message
- [Webhooks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/docs/guides/webhooks.md): the endpoint, signature checks, deduplication and the typed events
- [Embedded Signup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/docs/guides/embedded-signup.md): merchants connecting their own number, as Tech Provider or Solution Partner
- [CMS inbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/docs/guides/cms-inbox.md): merchant-to-customer chat, the 24-hour window, history and erasure
- [Marketing and commerce](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/docs/guides/marketing-and-commerce.md): opt-ins, marketing templates, catalogs and orders
- [WhatsApp OTP login](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/docs/guides/otp-login.md): authentication templates and one-time codes
- [Documents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/docs/guides/documents.md): invoices, receipts and vouchers rendered with Typst
- [Bots](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/docs/guides/bots.md): commands, middleware, plugins, broadcast and scheduling on webhooks
- [Production](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/docs/guides/production.md): secrets, logs, several instances, retention
- [Run the service](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/docs/guides/server.md): meta-whatsapp-server's configuration, keys, routes, webhooks, `doctor` and operations

## Architecture and design

- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/docs/architecture.md): the crates, the ports, the dependency rule and the stable identifiers

## Agent skills

One task each, installable with `npx skills add vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs`.

- [Skills index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/README.md): every skill and when to load it
- [meta-whatsapp-rs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs/SKILL.md): start here for the library, and which skill to load next
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-setup/SKILL.md): what to create on Meta's side, then building the client
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-send-messages](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-send-messages/SKILL.md): free-form text, media, location, contacts and reactions
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-send-templates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-send-templates/SKILL.md): sending an approved template with its parameters
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-templates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-templates/SKILL.md): creating and managing message templates
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-interactive-messages](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-interactive-messages/SKILL.md): reply buttons, lists, CTA URL buttons and more
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-media](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-media/SKILL.md): uploading, sending and downloading media
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-flows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-flows/SKILL.md): building Flow JSON and running WhatsApp Flows
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-webhook-endpoint](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-webhook-endpoint/SKILL.md): the webhook endpoint, its signature check and deduplication
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-webhook-events](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-webhook-events/SKILL.md): handling the typed webhook events
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-live-updates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-live-updates/SKILL.md): event sinks, fan-out and server-sent events
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-cms-inbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-cms-inbox/SKILL.md): a multi-tenant CMS's chat inbox
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-groups-and-calling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-groups-and-calling/SKILL.md): blocking users, groups and calls in an inbox
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-embedded-signup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-embedded-signup/SKILL.md): merchants connecting their own number
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-token-vault](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-token-vault/SKILL.md): merchants' tokens encrypted at rest, and key rotation
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-phone-numbers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-phone-numbers/SKILL.md): registering and managing business phone numbers and their WABA
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-otp-login](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-otp-login/SKILL.md): OTP login and phone verification
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-marketing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-marketing/SKILL.md): opt-ins and marketing messages
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-commerce](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-commerce/SKILL.md): commerce settings, catalogs and products
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-documents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-documents/SKILL.md): invoices, receipts and vouchers with Typst
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-bot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-bot/SKILL.md): a bot on Cloud API webhooks
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-storage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-storage/SKILL.md): choosing and running the key/value and conversation stores
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-errors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-errors/SKILL.md): the error tree and classifying failures
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-testing/SKILL.md): testing without Meta, a network or a database
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-production](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-production/SKILL.md): secrets, logs and several instances in production
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-server/SKILL.md): deploying and calling meta-whatsapp-server from an app not written in Rust
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-server-send](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-server-send/SKILL.md): messages, media and templates through the service
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-server-events](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-server-events/SKILL.md): Meta's webhooks and polled events through the service
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-server-otp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-server-otp/SKILL.md): WhatsApp login codes and authentication templates through the service
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-server-onboarding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-server-onboarding/SKILL.md): merchants connecting their WhatsApp number through the service (Embedded Signup), in both partner modes
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-server-registration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-server-registration/SKILL.md): a number's registration and two-step PIN through the service
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-server-marketing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-server-marketing/SKILL.md): marketing messages through the service: the Marketing Messages API send, max price, reach estimates and welcome message sequences, and the max price agreement, a legal act that stays off until the deployment enables it
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-server-number-settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-server-number-settings/SKILL.md): a number's settings through the service: the messaging limit tier, settings, payload encryption (keys never in a log or answer), username, Official Business Account, compliance information, health status, conversational components, and the legal acts that stay off until the deployment enables them
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-server-profile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-server-profile/SKILL.md): a number's profile picture and display name through the service: the picture from a completed upload, the display name's review
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-server-groups](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-server-groups/SKILL.md): a number's WhatsApp groups through the service: creation, invite links, participants, join requests, analytics
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-server-partners](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-server-partners/SKILL.md): partner APIs through the service: business verification status, solution migration intents, billing currency migrations, the operator's solutions and verification submissions, legal acts
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-server-calling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-server-calling/SKILL.md): a number's WhatsApp Calling through the service: settings, call permissions, placing and answering calls, recording and transcription, call analytics
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-server-broadcast](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-server-broadcast/SKILL.md): broadcasts through the service: one template queued for many people, paced, durable, read and cancelled
- [meta-whatsapp-rs-server-routing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaam-apps/meta-whatsapp-rs/main/skills/meta-whatsapp-rs-server-routing/SKILL.md): conversation routing through the service: routing roles, passing, taking and releasing a user's thread
